findings.text: §9(d) defines the fold's two shares as following "an earlier review of the same plan" (83% for duplicate_owner) and "a previous review whose same-type finding carries a stored response with action acted" (41.9%, 113 of 270), but the cited script (measure_review_cycles.py:585-644) resolves both over consecutive review pairs only, prev = reviews[i] and nxt = reviews[i+1], so the comparison is with the immediately preceding review; a node that reads "an earlier review" as any prior review of the plan counts more findings in the numerator and does not reproduce the 83% and 41.9% baselines
